notes.text: Don't retry the refresh_token grant as is. Since v3.2 Keyline rotates refresh tokens and revokes the whole token family when a used one is re-sent. A timeout can hit after the server rotated, so a plain retry signs every device out. Our vendor doc copy is v3.1 and predates this.
notes.author: codex

notes.text: Safe retry: send one Idempotency-Key header, reused across all attempts of the same refresh (transport.post(path, body, { headers })). Keyline (v3.4+) replays the first response for 60 s and skips reuse detection. Never reuse the key for a different refresh token.
notes.author: codex

notes.text: SessionGuard retries an API call once after a 401. A refresh that fails with 400 invalid_grant is never retried: the family is gone, so sign the user out.
notes.author: claude-code

notes.text: post() rejects with TransportError (code ETIMEDOUT or ECONNRESET) only when no HTTP response arrived. Extra headers such as Idempotency-Key go in options.headers.
notes.author: claude-code
